scale_note: Per-leg LOAD is 0-100 = hand-set pressure reading, same scale as the institutional dials: 0=slack, 100=at capacity. Every dial states its derivation in 'derive'. Register load counts are derived, not hand-set. The threshold row is the model's own output, not a score.

threshold.basis: Three legs fired (M, G, E) and the fourth (T) is drifting, not absent. The model's gate is 3 of 4: at 3 the system is eligible for a rupture, it does not guarantee one.
threshold.note: MGET names which engine is driving, never the outcome. The outcome channel is priced separately by the four lane cards below.

legs.name: Material
legs.question: Can the country still physically afford its own continuity?
legs.plain: Energy, food, money, supply chains — the physical throughput the system runs on. High means the base is rationed and every political fight is now a fight over scarcity.
legs.derive: Hand-set. Anchors: Hormuz constrained (not closed), the oil price shock feeding consumer cost, SPR drawdown, grain and fertiliser supply stress.
legs.why: The leg is fired on price and availability, not on shortage. Nothing has run out. The tell is that cost is now the transmission belt: it arrives in household budgets before it arrives in any statistic, which is why it moves politics faster than it moves the model.

legs.name: Governance
legs.question: Can the institutions still produce decisions anyone accepts?
legs.plain: Courts, Congress, election offices, agencies, the civil service, the military. High means they are still issuing orders, and fewer people are obeying them.
legs.derive: Derived: the mean of the eight institutional dials above (78.4, rounded). Moves only when they move, so the two panels cannot disagree.
legs.why: Five of eight dials sit in Critical. The courts still enjoin; the same docket is now aimed at election administration itself. Congress lost its own session day to avoid a floor vote. Nothing has stopped working. Everything is working against itself.

legs.name: Enclosure
legs.question: Who ends up owning the substrate everybody now depends on?
legs.plain: Surveillance systems, data, and the AI machinery. High means the dependency is being fenced into private hands faster than any rule can be written about it.
legs.derive: Hand-set. Anchors: ALPR and fusion-grid consolidation, press-access enclosure, scaffold-ownership as the live political fight.
legs.why: The lowest of the three fired legs, and the one that will outlast the others. Every other leg reverts when a government changes. This one reverts when a contract changes, which is rarer and slower.

legs.name: Turning
legs.question: Is the elite conflict still internal, or has something formed that could replace it?
legs.plain: Whether the fight is inside the old order between its own factions, or whether a new alignment has formed that could actually stand something up. High means the replacement exists. This is the leg that decides whether the period ends in repair or replacement.
legs.derive: Hand-set. Anchors: leg 4 reads drifting in the 2026-11-04 reading — strain is high, alignment is not formed.
legs.why: The highest reading on the board and the least measurable leg, which is exactly the problem: 39 of 88 cards are filed here and not one of them can still the question. Post-defeat routing is live, the vanguard split-or-fusion card is unresolved, and the succession question is 60 days old. Load is not evidence.
